title: Undone asks page still has its own reader

owner_note.text: /framework/ai/tasks/ and /tasks/ are now saved filters of the Inbox. /framework/ai/asks/undone/ keeps its own view because it reads undone.json (1167 asks) while state.json folds only 87; fold undone.json into Server/State.mjs and it can become ?kind=ask too. /live/ was left alone for you.
